question: What additional composite forms complete the described sacred structure?
premises: An eight-spoked lotus-petaled form is included
inference: The structure further includes an eight-spoked lotus-petaled form and a sixteen-and-one form.
uncertainties: The exact referent of ṣoḍaśaikaṃ is context-dependent
plain_english: O beautiful-faced one, it also has an eight-spoked lotus-petaled form and a sixteen-and-one form.
